title: Stack
subtitle: Next.js — React — Tailwind — Node — AWS — MySQL — Prisma.

cards.title: APIs (Node + Express)
cards.text: Routes, controllers, and middleware for clear, maintainable flows.
details: RESTful architecture with clear separation of responsibilities
Reusable middleware for auth, logging, and validation
Centralized error handling with consistent responses

cards.title: Auth and Roles
cards.text: JWT, refresh tokens, and RBAC for secure, granular access.
details: Complete flow, login, registration, refresh, and logout
Access control by roles and specific permissions
Best practices against common attacks, CSRF, XSS

cards.title: Data Layer
cards.text: MySQL or Postgres + Prisma, clear relationships and controlled migrations.
details: Typed Prisma schemas for full consistency
1:N and N:M relations with join tables
Seeds and fixtures for development and testing

proofText: Applied in real projects like Embipos POS API (Express + Prisma + MySQL).
